fixes.explanation: Ooh, I see why you paused, friend. But I checked, and this one is true. The Teacher says, “…and there are wicked men who get what the actions of the righteous deserve.” (Ecclesiastes 8:14) That's the second half of what he sees, right after the righteous men who get what the wicked deserve. He calls the whole thing futile, and I think he'd tell you it feels like opening a cookie box and finding the wrong cookies in it.
